1. Retry policy

The client retries idempotent requests with exponential backoff. Every retry doubles the delay until the ceiling is reached, and the ceiling itself is configurable per host. See the backoff reference, the limits section, and this unsafe link.

重试策略只适用于幂等请求。默认最多重试三次，每次等待时间翻倍，直到达到上限为止；上限可以按主机单独配置。

1.1 Configuration

Set the policy when the client is created. The options object is frozen after creation, so later changes have no effect on requests that are already in flight.

const client = createClient({
  retries: 3,
  // # not a heading
  backoff: 'exponential',
})

1.1.1 Limits

OptionDefaultMaximum
retries310
ceiling30s300s

1.2 Observability

Each retry emits a retry event carrying the attempt number and the delay that was applied.

  • Attempt numbers start at one.
  • The final failure is reported once, after the last attempt.
